description: Small reproducible retrieval fixture. Documents and relevance labels were authored for software validation; labels are not human judgments and do not establish benchmark quality.

documents.title: BERT for Extractive Question Answering
documents.text: BERT fine-tuning on the SQuAD dataset improves extractive question answering by predicting answer spans from contextual token representations.

documents.title: Message Passing in Graph Neural Networks
documents.text: Graph neural networks aggregate messages from neighboring nodes for node classification and graph representation learning.

documents.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Genome Editing
documents.text: CRISPR-Cas9 uses guide RNA to target genomic loci for programmable genome editing.

documents.title: Climate Change and Atmospheric Warming
documents.text: Climate observations measure atmospheric warming and changes in global temperature over time.

documents.title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
documents.text: Convolutional neural networks segment medical images and are evaluated using the Dice coefficient.
